verses.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
verses.pt: Depois destas coisas vi descer do céu outro anjo que tinha grande autoridade, e a terra foi iluminada com a sua glória.
verses.en_web: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.
verses.en_bbe: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was bright with his glory.

verses.en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.pt: E ele clamou com voz forte, dizendo: Caiu, caiu a grande Babilônia, e se tornou morada de demônios, e guarida de todo espírito imundo, e guarida de toda ave imunda e detestável.
verses.en_web: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!
verses.en_bbe: And he gave a loud cry, saying, Babylon the great has come down from her high place, she has come to destruction and has become a place of evil spirits, and of every unclean spirit, and a hole for every unclean and hated bird.

verses.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
verses.pt: Porque todas as nações têm bebido do vinho da ira da sua prostituição, e os reis da terra se prostituíram com ela; e os mercadores da terra se enriqueceram com a abundância de suas delícias.
verses.en_web: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”
verses.en_bbe: For through the wine of the wrath of her evil desires all the nations have come to destruction; and the kings of the earth made themselves unclean with her, and the traders of the earth had their wealth increased by the power of her evil ways.

verses.en: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
verses.pt: Ouvi outra voz do céu dizer: Sai dela, povo meu, para que não sejas participante dos sete pecados, e para que não incorras nas suas pragas.
verses.en_web: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,
verses.en_bbe: And another voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Come out of her, my people, so that you may have no part in her sins and in her punishments.

verses.en: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
verses.pt: Porque os seus pecados se acumularam até o céu, e Deus se lembrou das iniqüidades dela.
verses.en_web: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: For her sins have gone up even to heaven, and God has taken note of her evil-doing.

verses.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
verses.pt: Tornai a dar-lhe como também ela vos tem dado, e retribuí-lhe em dobro conforme as suas obras; no cálice em que vos deu de beber dai-lhe a ela em dobro.
verses.en_web: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.
verses.en_bbe: Give to her as she gave, even an increased reward for her works; in the cup which was mixed by her, let there be mixed as much again for herself.

verses.en: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
verses.pt: Quanto ela se glorificou, e em delícias esteve, tanto lhe dai de tormento e de pranto; pois que ela diz em seu coração: Estou assentada como rainha, e não sou viúva, e de modo algum verei o pranto.
verses.en_web: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’
verses.en_bbe: As she gave glory to herself, and became more evil in her ways, in the same measure give her pain and weeping: for she says in her heart, I am seated here a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see sorrow.

verses.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
verses.pt: Por isso, num mesmo dia virão as suas pragas, a morte, e o pranto, e a fome; e será consumida no fogo; porque forte é o Senhor Deus que a julga.
verses.en_web: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason in one day will her troubles come, death and sorrow and need of food; and she will be completely burned with fire; for strong is the Lord God who is her judge.

verses.en: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
verses.pt: E os reis da terra, que com ela se prostituíram e viveram em delícias, sobre ela chorarão e prantearão, quando virem a fumaça do seu incêndio;
verses.en_web: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,
verses.en_bbe: And the kings of the earth, who made themselves unclean with her, and in her company gave themselves up to evil, will be weeping and crying over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,

verses.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
verses.pt: e, estando de longe por medo do tormento dela, dirão: Ai! ai da grande cidade, Babilônia, a cidade forte! pois numa só hora veio o teu julgamento.
verses.en_web: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’
verses.en_bbe: Watching from far away, for fear of her punishment, saying, Sorrow, sorrow for Babylon, the great town, the strong town! for in one hour you have been judged.

verses.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
verses.pt: E sobre ela choram e lamentam os mercadores da terra; porque ninguém compra mais as suas mercadorias:
verses.en_web: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;
verses.en_bbe: And the traders of the earth are weeping and crying over her, because no man has any more desire for their goods,

verses.en: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
verses.pt: mercadorias de ouro, de prata, de pedras preciosas, de pérolas, de linho fino, de púrpura, de seda e de escarlata; e toda espécie de madeira odorífera, e todo objeto de marfim, de madeira preciosíssima, de bronze, de ferro e de mármore;
verses.en_web: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;
verses.en_bbe: Gold, and silver, and stones of great price, and jewels, and delicate linen, and robes of purple and silk and red; and perfumed wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of fair wood, and of brass, and iron, and stone;

verses.en: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
verses.pt: e canela, especiarias, perfume, mirra e incenso; e vinho, azeite, flor de farinha e trigo; e gado, ovelhas, cavalos e carros; e escravos, e até almas de homens.
verses.en_web: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.
verses.en_bbe: And sweet-smelling plants, and perfumes, and wine, and oil, and well crushed grain, and cattle and sheep; and horses and carriages and servants; and souls of men.

verses.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
verses.pt: Também os frutos que a tua alma cobiçava foram-se de ti; e todas as coisas delicadas e suntuosas se foram de ti, e nunca mais se acharão.
verses.en_web: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.
verses.en_bbe: And the fruit of your soul's desire has gone from you, and all things delicate and shining have come to an end and will never again be seen.

verses.en: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
verses.pt: Os mercadores destas coisas, que por ela se enriqueceram, ficarão de longe por medo do tormento dela, chorando e lamentando,
verses.en_web: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;
verses.en_bbe: The traders in these things, by which their wealth was increased, will be watching far off for fear of her punishment, weeping and crying;

verses.en: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
verses.pt: dizendo: Ai! ai da grande cidade, da que estava vestida de linho fino, de púrpura, de escarlata, e adornada com ouro, e pedras preciosas, e pérolas! porque numa só hora foram assoladas tantas riquezas.
verses.en_web: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, she who was clothed in delicate linen, and purple, and red; with ornaments of gold and stones of great price and jewels!

verses.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
verses.pt: E todo piloto, e todo o que navega para qualquer porto e todos os marinheiros, e todos os que trabalham no mar se puseram de longe;
verses.en_web: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every ship master, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,
verses.en_bbe: For in one hour such great wealth has come to nothing. And every shipmaster, and all who are sailing on the sea, and sailors and all who get their living by the sea, were watching from far away,

verses.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
verses.pt: e, contemplando a fumaça do incêndio dela, clamavam: Que cidade é semelhante a esta grande cidade?
verses.en_web: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’
verses.en_bbe: And crying out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What town is like the great town?

verses.en: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
verses.pt: E lançaram pó sobre as suas cabeças, e clamavam, chorando e lamentando, dizendo: Ai! ai da grande cidade, na qual todos os que tinham naus no mar se enriqueceram em razão da sua opulência! porque numa só hora foi assolada.
verses.en_web: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For she is made desolate in one hour.
verses.en_bbe: And they put dust on their heads, and were sad, weeping and crying, and saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, in which was increased the wealth of all who had their ships on the sea because of her great stores! for in one hour she is made waste.

verses.en: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
verses.pt: Exulta sobre ela, ó céu, e vós, santos e apóstolos e profetas; porque Deus vindicou a vossa causa contra ela.
verses.en_web: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
verses.en_bbe: Be glad over her, heaven, and you saints, and Apostles, and prophets; because she has been judged by God on your account.

verses.en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
verses.pt: Um forte anjo levantou uma pedra, qual uma grande mó, e lançou-a no mar, dizendo: Com igual ímpeto será lançada Babilônia, a grande cidade, e nunca mais será achada.
verses.en_web: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.
verses.en_bbe: And a strong angel took up a stone like the great stone with which grain is crushed, and sent it into the sea, saying, So, with a great fall, will Babylon, the great town, come to destruction, and will not be seen any more at all.

verses.en: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
verses.pt: E em ti não se ouvirá mais o som de harpistas, de músicos, de flautistas e de trombeteiros; e nenhum artífice de arte alguma se achará mais em ti; e em ti não mais se ouvirá ruído de mó;
verses.en_web: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.
verses.en_bbe: And the voice of players and makers of music will never again be sounding in you: and no worker, expert in art, will ever again be living in you; and there will be no sound of the crushing of grain any more at all in you;

verses.en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
verses.pt: e luz de candeia não mais brilhará em ti, e voz de noivo e de noiva não mais em ti se ouvirá; porque os teus mercadores eram os grandes da terra; porque todas as nações foram enganadas pelas tuas feitiçarias.
verses.en_web: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.
verses.en_bbe: And never again will the shining of lights be seen in you; and the voice of the newly-married man and the bride will never again be sounding in you: for your traders were the lords of the earth, and by your evil powers were all the nations turned out of the right way.

verses.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
verses.pt: E nela se achou o sangue dos profetas, e dos santos, e de todos os que foram mortos na terra.
verses.en_web: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And in her was seen the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been put to death on the earth.
